Definition: Jonadab, the name of an Israelite and of a Rechabite
BiblicalUsage: Jonadab is named 6 times in the Bible, and the passages here are 2 Samuel 13:3; 2 Samuel 13:32; Jeremiah 35:6. In 2 Samuel 13:3 we read, "But Amnon had a friend, whose name was Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David's brother: and Jonadab was a very subtil man." It appears again in Jeremiah 35:6: "But they said, We will drink no wine: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying..."
TheologicalSignificance: Jonadab stands in the record, and I am glad God kept it there. His name stands in the record, and that is enough for me.
